'''Mike''' is a minor character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] and its preceding machinima, [[The Introduction]]. He is a member of the [[Leone Family]].

==Character history==
Mike, presumably born in [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], joined the [[Leone Family]] at an unknown time and later became the bodyguard of [[Salvatore Leone]], including for his time in [[Las Venturas]] after he invested [[money]] in [[Caligula's Palace]]. Mike appears briefly in [[The Introduction]] and the mission [[Freefall]] in the background, quietly following Salvatore.
